text:
Hey Nick,

Apologies if there was any confusion today on the credit only reflecting
$11,700.

When you get a chance could you please send over the updated Jiminy
agreement or the latest invoice that reflects the 10 additional users to
get to the $14,400 total? That way, I can submit it to my director for a
complete buyout of Jiminy on a two-year agreement (instead of a 3 year,
sorry that was my bad today) and there won't be any overlap in the
agreements to create the least amount of friction for you to get approval.

Besides that, I'm glad you and Eric found the business case metrics and ROI
insights we gleaned from the short pilot period interesting and that they
aligned quite well to support Encord's #1 priority of decreasing ramp time
from 6 months to 3 months and proved out the mutual success plan we defined
in the beginning.

That being said, I'm confident we can find a path to pricing that will work
well for both sides and am excited at the opportunity to partner.

Once I have the new invoice, there are a few options we can explore
depending on your feedback and recommendations, however, the 2 that seem to
align with your goals the most will be a total buyout:

*Full Buyout for 16 Users: *Lower total contract value

   - $7,200 Credit applied off Gong Agreement for 16 licenses Year 1
   - $11,520 Credit applied off Gong Agreement for 16 licenses Year 2

*Full Buyout for 20 Users: *Higher total contract value due to higher user
count than we originally discussed

   - $9,000 Credit applied off Gong Agreement for 20 licenses Year 1
   - $14,400 Credit applied off Gong Agreement for 20 licenses Year 2

I also have a few ideas to bounce off you for how we could get creative
with partial credits and partial discounts to help with scaling costs long
term or exploring a 3-year agreement if that is something you are open to.

Let me know when you have 5 minutes to discuss today or tomorrow.

subject: Re: Encord | Questions to support commercial proposal
text:
Hi James,

Thank you for following up. We spoke as a team this morning and have
decided to pause our exploration with Encord. From our discussions, Encord
is not a fit for us today. The product simply does not solve our current
challenges yet. However, we are open to chat in the future as there were
many things that impressed us.

The two major factors for the decision to pause were:

1. We want to keep/maintain our backend design. We understand that some
transformations are needed to work with any front end. However, it looks to
be a larger set of work to prepare the data to be ingested by Encord.
2. We would like full support of Lidar. While it is clear that you are the
path to supporting Lidar, we will need more than just visualising point
clouds. We need a more advanced approach in which we can move around the
entire scene in 3D.

Finally, there is still a lot of work to do in order to get the data lake
house up and running. We want to execute on the remaining bits so Oxa can
benefit from the simplified access to data.

Thanks for your help.

Cheers,
Rick

subject: Encord & Smart Surgery Tek
text:
Hi Dillon,

Thank you for taking the time to answer our questions today. We truly appreciate your support and are genuinely impressed by the features that Encord provides.

We would like to proceed with Encord and have outlined the following action items: 

* **Trial Program**: We aim to kick off the trial program as early as next week, if possible. Could we set up a trial period of at least 30 days to fully explore and evaluate the impressive features of Encord?

* **Partnership**: We are dedicated to sharing our good relationship with Encord during the Surgical Data Science (SDS) Summer School at the Institute of Image-Guided Surgery (IHU Strasbourg) in July, the upcoming MICCAI conference in Korea in September and within the AI community in Taiwan.

* **License**: We are interested in applying for the STARTER license (5 users). Could you assist us in obtaining the best possible offer to support our medtech startup? Your help would be greatly appreciated.

* **Training**: We are eager to begin the annotator training as soon as possible: https://encord.com/annotator-training/.

* **Legacy Data Conversion**: We have existing labeled data in both custom and CVAT formats. What steps are needed to convert this legacy data into Encord?

* **Legacy Video Conversion**: Previously, we divided long videos into individual images captured every three seconds. Does Encord offer a built-in function to easily compile these images back into a video for annotation purposes?

**Mar 16th - Meeting Notes:**
- Best support for Surgical Video annotation
- Support for multi-feature annotation user experience
- Support for both temporal and spatial feature annotation
- Support for GCP cloud-based storage
- Support for Segment Anything, including foundational models and fine-tuning for automated annotation
- Support for brush tooling
- Support for video editing by timeframe
- Support for DICOM natively without additional transformation (e.g., point cloud for 3D information)
- Does NOT sup

subject: Re: Encord <> Shinkei
text:
Hi Shivant,

I started looking into using the SDK and noticed something a bit concerning. The line "EncordUserClient.create_with_ssh_private_key()" requires passing in the path to a direct SSH private key. I wanted to flag this as a potential security concern - it's easy for users, especially new to the platform or early in career, to accidentally pass their primary SSH keys that are often also used for GitHub access. This could have broader security implications and bypasses protections from the ssh-agent.

Has the team considered supporting API tokens, OAuth, or using the ssh-agent? At minimum, clearly specifying the use of an Encord specific ssh key in the docs would be useful!

Again, I just wanted to flag for customer use and security reasons to make sure you guys are covered. This is the documentation I checked to verify if an Encord specific key is recommended.

https://docs.encord.com/sdk-documentation/getting-started-sdk/global-us-customers

Best,

Jen Isaza

Lead Software Engineer | Shinkei Systems

shinkei.systems | jeni@shinkei.systems

Sent via Superhuman ( https://sprh.mn/?vip=jeni@shinkei.systems )
